title: security: RBAC v2 enforcement + KMS region residency audit hardening
author: Priya Patel
description: Summary: Enforce RBAC v2 policies for KMS key usage, add region residency checks, and harden audit logging for all key-material-related operations. Motivation: Customers in regulated industries require strict enforcement that KMS keys used for dataset/material encryption live in allowed regions and that RBAC decisions are auditable and tamper-evident. This PR implements enforcement (opt-in via feature flag), comprehensive audit events, migration tooling for existing key bindings, and unit + integration tests. Checklist: - [x] RBAC v2 enforcement hooks added to KMS access path - [x] Region residency policy evaluation and enforcement - [x] Audit events for grant/usage/change of KMS bindings (structured JSON payloads) - [x] DB migration to add kms_residency column + backfill script - [x] End-to-end tests + policy test fixtures - [x] Documentation updates and release notes draft - [x] Feature flag: rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce (default: false) Changes in this PR: 1) core/authz: Integrates RBAC v2 decision point into the KMS access layer. When the feature flag rbac_v2_kms_residency_enforce is true, KMS operations (Encrypt/Decrypt/Grant/Revoke) require a positive allow decision and a matching kms_region constraint on the resource. 2) core/kms: Added region validator and residency resolver. Residency resolver supports explicit region pinning and tenancy defaults. 3) db/migrations: new migration 20260212_add_kms_residency.sql to add kms_residency varchar to kms_key_bindings table and a lightweight backfill that tags keys by inspecting existing metadata/ARNs. 4) audit: audit events augmented with canonical fields: actor_id, actor_role, resource_type, resource_id, kms_region, decision, policy_id, request_id, and an hmac_signature field for tamper evidence. 5) tooling/migrations: migration helper to preview keys that would be blocked if enforcement is enabled. 6) tests: unit tests for policy evaluation, integration tests exercising real KMS stubs across regions, and an e2e test demonstrating an enforcement failure path. 7) docs: security/rbac-v2-kms-region.md with guidance and migration steps. Backwards compatibility: Enforcement behind feature flag. Migration script required for customers that have KMS bindings without explicit region. Rollout plan: 1) Ship with flag=false and audit-only events populated 2) Run backfill and notify customers with preview tool 3) Flip flag to true for opt-in customers 4) Gradual enforcement for all customers after 30-day notice (see release_notes) Related: Linear ENG-8421, ENG-8476, PM-921. Links: Linear: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-8421, Design doc: /docs/design/rbac-v2-kms-residency.md, KMS compliance checklist: /docs/security/kms-residency-checklist.md
